t: A Boer republic north of the Vaal River, founded by Voortrekkers and recognised by Britain in the Sand River Convention of 1852.
Gold found on the Witwatersrand in 1886 made it the richest state in Africa and created the city of Johannesburg.
Conflict with Britain over the gold fields and the rights of foreign uitlanders led to the Second Boer War and its end in 1902.
dyk: Pretoria was named after the Voortrekker leader Andries Pretorius by his son Marthinus Wessel Pretorius, who founded the town in 1855 and became the republic’s first president.
ev: The Sand River Convention recognises Boer independence north of the Vaal
Pretoria becomes the seat of government
The Boers defeat a British force at Majuba Hill and regain self-government
Gold is discovered on the Witwatersrand and Johannesburg is founded
The Jameson Raid ends in surrender at Doornkop
The Second Boer War begins after a Transvaal ultimatum expires
The Treaty of Vereeniging makes the republic the Transvaal Colony

f.predecessor: Potchefstroom Republic and the other Voortrekker communities north of the Vaal
